industry.structure: Semiconductor burn-in and test is a niche within wafer-fabrication equipment; Aehr competes with custom in-house test and broader ATE vendors on FOX-XP and WaferPak systems. Gross margins near 40% at scale but orders are lumpy.
industry.share_shift: Aehr gained share during the 2023–2024 SiC upcycle; FY2025–FY2026 trough reversed as bookings and effective backlog rebuilt to ~$100.6M into FY2027.
industry.trend: SiC and AI accelerator burn-in remain growth narratives; FY2026 Q4 inflection and FY2027 guidance improve visibility but 77% top-five customer concentration and ATM dilution keep earnings lumpy.
